title: Choose the visual world for the JOOX CARS light site
question: The roll assigned Road Atlas. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Every option keeps the JOOX film hero and the logo's yellow and black on a light page.

options.label: Road Atlas
options.lineage: Costa Rican road atlases: numbered routes, contour tints, map legends
options.thesis: The homepage is an atlas page: each service is a stop, and one yellow route line carries you from US auction to Costa Rican road.
materials: the JOOX film as a map plate
options.viewport: The JOOX film full-width as the atlas plate with route-number captions; below it the yellow line leaves the frame and threads rental, import, parts and sales as map stops, rental first.
options.risk: Maps can drift into illustration; the line must stay a route and a data graphic, never drawn scenery.

raised.raise: All the yellow is spent on one continuous route line and the primary button; everything else is white, ink and map tint.
The four service stops are big thumb-first tap targets held on a strict hidden grid.
Each stop stays folded flat until opened, then unfolds its prices, steps and WhatsApp action.
One graticule grid rules every section; phones scale it, never break it.
Palette law: each colour has one job, and yellow only ever means route or action.

options.label: Road Signage
options.lineage: Costa Rican MOPT road signs: yellow warning diamonds, black chevrons, white route shields
options.thesis: JOOX's yellow and black are the colours of the road itself, so the site speaks in sign panels.
options.viewport: A white page with the JOOX film framed like a road-side board; the four services as sign panels with plain instructions, rental first.
options.risk: The most familiar route for a yellow-and-black car brand, and it can tip into construction-zone kitsch.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.lineage: museum provenance records: one object's custody traced through time
options.thesis: Each car's life as one continuous line: US auction lot, shipping, customs, the JOOX road.
options.viewport: The film, then one car's documented journey as a ribbon of dated stops, known steps solid and pending ones in hairline.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with import transparency and the fleet as proof, but loses on a rental-first lead, where tourists want a car, not a dossier.
options.risk: Reads like paperwork if the ribbon stops feeling alive.

options.label: Civic Prospectus
options.thesis: One rendered ribbon carries all the colour across a white prospectus.
options.viewport: Headline left, ribbon bleeding right, a row of partner seals below.
options.case: Fuses into the stiff corporate look you ruled out.
options.kept: Total commitment of colour to one continuous element.

options.label: Rebel Menu
options.lineage: stylised game menus in torn paper
options.thesis: Every choice is a torn shard slammed on a red wall.
options.viewport: A full-frame red splash with the four services as tilted cutouts.
options.case: Fuses into the cheap or loud look you ruled out.
options.kept: Thumb-first choices on a hidden grid.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.thesis: Services as paper lanterns that light up when opened.
options.viewport: Glowing folded volumes in a dim room.
options.case: Fuses weakly: nothing in a car brand's world is paper and lamplight.
options.kept: Details stay folded flat until you open them.
options.risk: Warm and soft where JOOX is bold.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The site as numbered teletext pages.
options.viewport: An index page with each service on its own numbered page.
options.case: Fuses as retro novelty on black, against a light brief.
options.kept: One sacred grid that scales, never breaks.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.thesis: A 240-line arcade stage with real glow.
options.viewport: A pixel car drives across a scanline screen.
options.case: Fuses into a game, not a rental you trust.
options.kept: Palette law: each colour has one job.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, light car-rental site, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A hero photo with a pickup/return date bar, then a grid of fleet cards with daily prices and a services row.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every rental site, closest to the dealership feel you want to avoid.

roll.note: First run came back degraded; rerun from the same key with --candidate-count 7 returned source: api. The user chose option 'assigned' (Road Atlas).
